evidence.detail: The class directly extends RSInterface, constructs itself into the global interface table, uses widget type 42 and owns selection/open/layout state for one option list.

Its static factory accepts String options, wraps each in rs/n/a/a/d, initializes display text to the first option and default action text to 'Select', and its selection method updates the displayed text from the selected option.
R118 DropdownPacketHandler targets exactly this class and updates its option/display state through ScriptPacket ID 40.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the custom dropdown RSInterface subtype targeted by R118.

evidence.detail: The class is a two-String value object used exclusively as entries in DropdownInterface's option List; one String is the displayed text and the second is the action/value label.
Its exact toString output begins 'DropDownOption(text=', preserving the source/domain noun directly in v308 bytecode.
DropdownInterface constructs one DropDownOption per supplied option and reads the selected entry's text when the dropdown selection changes.

candidates.note: Name uses the exact surviving DropDownOption token from the class's own toString representation.
